original: Archive-provided LITMOD binary, unchanged, serial CPU; shipped DRAM schedule
scope: RF-only, known two finite constant velocity layers; 4 free physical parameters; input adaptation of authors' sampler
distinction: Not a literal replication of the paper's 12-control shallow RF+polarization inversion
primary: clean RF RMSE of full-chain posterior predictive mean; mean Vs-profile depth-integrated RMSE
truth_selection: Previously fixed held-out model source IDs 2000000000003 and 2000000000071
modifications_for_common_target: Source empirical Vp/rho and depth-dependent Q; tau=0 known, one p=.06652, no ray spread, independent Gaussian RF noise; same for both
cpu_execution: At most 8 independent original serial processes on remote CPU; no alteration/threading of the sampler
original_seed_environment: TZ=Asia/Shanghai; staggered process launches. Original seed formula multiplies by timezone offset and collapses to zero under UTC
initialization: Flow 2048 K=2 proposals from observed RF bridge view plus 2048 uniform prior proposals; same candidates and data-only selection
bridge: Normalize each observed raw RF by observed P amplitude and repeat the single ray into 3 network ray slots; this is outside trained ray-bin/noise distribution
caution: Frozen learned models are used only as candidate generators; this experiment does not validate their posterior calibration or network-force HMC
exact_forward: Original theo/qlayer/four1 FP32 and GRTM float64 constant Q with original complex horizontal slowness; nfft2048, dt.2, n151, bands1/2.5/4
ignored_input_fields: Original litmod overwrites configured Vp/Vs, rho and Q with source relationships; no dead nuisance parameters sampled
